title: Empty catch block.
summary: Try adding statements to the block, adding a comment to the block, or removing the 'catch' clause. Its category is style. It is stable since Dart 2.0.

title: Empty constructor bodies should be written using a ';' rather than '…'.
summary: Try replacing the constructor body with ';'. Its category is brevity, effectiveDart, style. It is stable since Dart 2.0.
message_templates: Empty constructor bodies should be written using a ';' rather than '{}'.

title: Empty … bodies should be written using a ';' rather than '…'.
summary: Try replacing the … body with ';'. Its category is style. It is stable since Dart 3.13.
message_templates: Empty {} bodies should be written using a ';' rather than '{}'.

title: A map pattern must have at least one entry.
